adopted_model: Fixed ICRS catalog direction; no proper motion, parallax, perspective acceleration, aberration, light deflection, light time or refraction. Precession-nutation is an orientation change, not stellar propagation.

observer.height_assumption: Geometric simplification; not a measured elevation

earth_orientation.celestial_pole_corrections: omitted; direct BPN path without UTC/EOP adapter

time_convention: UT1 calendar labels -> native Tempoch UT1 axis -> TT through the pinned historical Delta T model. No UTC or leap-second conversion.
proper_motion_omission_note: Fixed catalog direction retained; catalog motion would accumulate about 2.7 arcsec between 1896 and J2000. Numerical agreement is not an assessment of the historical stellar position.

event_search.provider: local HistoricalAntares implementing AltitudeProvider with the same geometric function as the grid

historical_delta_t.uncertainty: Conservative historical-model accuracy allowance +/-15 s from the pinned scale documentation; not a statistical standard error or a measured EOP uncertainty.
